title: markdown-index wikilink graph
description: The graph of wikilinks and inline tags: every edge keyed by its content address, the same address EdgeCID computes. Identical edges share a content address and dedupe to a single entry.

wikilink.title: markdown-index wikilink
wikilink.description: One graph edge: a resolved wikilink, or an inline tag.

label.description: WEBSITE when the target begins http:// or https://, INTERNAL for every other wikilink. TAG is an inline #tag in the markdown body: the text without # is carried in both title and to_document_id, and it is not resolved to a document UUID. Front matter tags do not produce this label.

title.description: The pipe alias when the wikilink has one, otherwise the raw target text. For a TAG edge, the tag text without the leading #.

from_document_id.description: UUID of the document holding the wikilink. Only documents with a non-empty UUID produce edges.

to_document_id.description: The target's UUID when the link resolves in the index, otherwise the raw target text. For a TAG edge, the tag text, not a document UUID.
